name: Tebra (Kareo) Billing vs SimplePractice
title: Tebra (Kareo) Billing vs SimplePractice: Medical Billing Comparison 2026
description: Compare Tebra (Kareo) billing software with SimplePractice for healthcare practices. See pricing, RCM features, and which is best for medical vs mental health billing.

summary.bottom_line: Tebra (Kareo) is a modular practice management and billing platform designed for diverse medical specialties with optional managed billing services. SimplePractice is an all-in-one platform purpose-built for health and wellness professionals including therapists. Choose Tebra for multi-specialty medical practices or managed RCM services, SimplePractice for mental health and wellness practices.

sections.heading: Tebra (Kareo) vs SimplePractice: Different Markets
sections.content: Tebra (formerly Kareo, merged with PatientPop in 2021) and SimplePractice serve different primary markets. Tebra is designed for independent medical practices across specialties - primary care, pediatrics, dermatology, orthopedics - with modular billing, EHR, and patient marketing solutions. SimplePractice is built for health and wellness professionals, particularly therapists, counselors, nutritionists, and similar practitioners. The billing needs of a multi-specialty medical practice differ significantly from a therapy practice.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: Tebra offers modular pricing: billing software starts at $125/month, combined billing + EHR at $250/provider/month, with managed billing services (full-service RCM) at 4-8% of collections. SimplePractice bundles everything at $99/month (Plus plan) with per-claim fees of $0.25. For therapy practices, SimplePractice is typically more cost-effective. For medical practices needing managed billing services or advanced RCM, Tebra's options provide more flexibility.

sections.heading: Billing & RCM Capabilities
sections.content: Tebra has stronger billing infrastructure: automated claim scrubbing, denial management, ERA/EOB processing, and optional managed billing services where Tebra staff handles your entire revenue cycle. SimplePractice has solid billing for therapy practices but is designed for simpler claim workflows typical in mental health. Tebra also integrates with labs (Quest, LabCorp) and has e-prescribing included - SimplePractice charges extra for e-prescribing.

sections.heading: Practice Type Considerations
sections.content: SimplePractice excels in mental health with purpose-built progress note templates, treatment planning, and client portal features designed for therapy workflows. Tebra is more generic across medical specialties. Tebra's PatientPop merger brings patient marketing and acquisition features. SimplePractice has a larger user base (250K vs 100K) concentrated in wellness. For mental health practices specifically, SimplePractice is typically the better choice.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Consider your practice type and billing needs:

recommendations.when: You're a therapist, counselor, or wellness professional wanting purpose-built mental health features and simpler billing workflows
You're a multi-specialty medical practice needing advanced RCM features, lab integrations, and e-prescribing included
You want managed billing services where someone else handles your entire revenue cycle (4-8% of collections)
Budget is important and you want all-in-one pricing at $99/month for EHR, billing, telehealth, and scheduling
You need patient marketing and acquisition features (PatientPop) alongside practice management

faqs.a: Yes, Kareo merged with PatientPop in 2021 to form Tebra. The billing and practice management features are still available under the Tebra brand, now combined with PatientPop's patient acquisition tools.

faqs.q: Does Tebra offer managed billing services?
faqs.a: Yes, Tebra offers managed billing (full-service RCM) where their staff handles claims management, denial follow-up, and patient collections. This typically costs 4-8% of collections. SimplePractice does not offer managed billing services.

faqs.q: Is SimplePractice good for medical practices?
faqs.a: SimplePractice is designed for health and wellness professionals, particularly therapists and counselors. For medical practices needing lab integrations, complex billing, or specialty-specific workflows, Tebra (Kareo) or other medical EHRs may be better suited.

faqs.q: Which has better mental health features?
faqs.a: SimplePractice has significantly better mental health features with purpose-built progress note templates, treatment planning, and therapy-specific workflows. Tebra works for mental health but uses more generic medical templates.
